verdict.rationale: Ollama is an API-serving model runtime with a cloud offering, so outbound event webhooks are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only a request/response REST API, an OpenAPI spec, SDKs, and agent integrations; nothing shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The OpenClaw messaging-app connections (WhatsApp, Slack, Discord) are chat integrations, not webhooks, and the REST API is a developer building block, not an event subscription mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
